prompt_md: Six friends raise their glasses, and every pair of them clinks glasses exactly once. How many clinks are there?
prompt_short: Six friends, every pair clinks glasses once. How many clinks?
hint_md: When Ana clinks with Ben, that's the same clink as Ben clinking with Ana.
explain_intuition_md: Each of the 6 clinks with 5 others, which gives 30. But that counts every clink twice, once from each side. Halve it to get 15.
